name: User Menu Customizer for HivePress
author: Tycoonverse

sections.description:
User Menu Customizer for HivePress allows you to personalize the HivePress user account menu in the header navigation without coding. This plugin addresses the lack of native customization options in HivePress, offering a user-friendly interface to:

– Toggle visibility of the user menu and its submenu (Listings, Settings, Sign Out).
– Customize text/icon color and background color.
– Adjust padding inside the menu button.

All settings are managed via Appearance > Customize > HivePress User Menu. This plugin requires the HivePress plugin to be installed and active.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the user-menu-customizer-for-hivepress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Customize > HivePress User Menu to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require HivePress?

Yes, this plugin requires the HivePress plugin to be installed and active.

Can I customize the menu without coding?

Absolutely! All customizations are done via the WordPress Customizer, no coding required.

  • Updated Customizer descriptions for clarity.
